BL-1074 — Mean ticket time reads a closed ticket's END as its latest re-file, not its close, so every ticket ever moved under a milestone directory reports an inflated duration - 308 of the 802 closed tickets today
What it solves: Measured on this host at spec time, from `main` (local `main` 26 ahead / 0
behind `origin/main`, so it is the fresher ref):
Approval context: This is a sibling defect deferred out of BL-1066 by BOTH the coder and the architect, who each declined to fix it inside that parcel and asked the specifier to decide whether it earns its own ticket. It does, and this is it. Nothing here changes what BL-1066 built; it changes what one number MEANS.…
BL-1074 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1074" (or "reject BL-1074 <reason>") to act.
